compoundYield(uint256).details: Reinvests yield WITHOUT withdrawing stETH to safeMultisig.         The wstETH already held by Aave grows via rebase — this         function simply recognises that growth as new principal         and updates totalDeployed so future yield calculations         compound on the larger base.         NO ETH leaves the contract.         NO new ETH is required.         NO existing state is modified except totalDeployed.         ALL existing guards (attestation, health factor, cap)         are identical to deployLongLeg() — dynamic is unchanged.         Recommended: call weekly via keeper bot.         Gas cost: ~$0.03 at current gas prices.

params.compoundAmount: stETH equivalent to recognise as compounded                         principal (must be <= accrued yield)

deployLongLeg().details: CAPITAL SOURCE: ETH must come from the Safe multisig treasury only.      Individual NFT holders and end users do NOT call this function and      do NOT send ETH to this contract. See contract header for full      capital flow architecture (Track A vs Track B).      ETH flow: msg.value (from Safe) → stETH (Lido) → wstETH → Aave v3      Step 1: ETH → stETH via Lido submit()      Step 2: stETH → wstETH via IWstETH.wrap() (Aave v3 requires wstETH)      Step 3: wstETH → Aave v3 supply()      maxDeployment cap = LAYER3_ETH_TOTAL (6,391 ETH) from EWBLayer3Token.      This ensures yield strategy never exceeds the NFT collateral backing.      Hedge sizing: bot calls submitHedgeAttestation() after each deploy.      Target: shortNotional == totalDeployed (delta = 0, ±5% tolerance)

executeAaveWithdrawal().details: Idempotent — safe to retry if gas fails      If Aave is paused, call setAavePaused(true) and wait

executeUnwrapToStETH().details: Idempotent — if already unwrapped, moves to stage 3

forceAdvanceExitStage().details: Only callable after EXIT_STAGE_TIMEOUT has elapsed      Owner must manually handle the stuck stage off-chain

harvestYield(uint256).details: Anyone can trigger harvest when yield >= threshold      Removes owner gate — cannot be blocked by compromised key      Yield always routes to safeMultisig — cannot be redirected

initiateEmergencyExit().details: Pauses all operations. Sets EXIT_IN_PROGRESS.      Call this first then execute stages in order.

params._alert: True if Lido withdrawal queue is congested.

params._seconds: Timelock in seconds. 0 for instant, up to 604800 (7 days).

withdrawAll().details: Fully exits Aave position. Returned ETH goes to Safe multisig.

EXIT_STAGE_TIMEOUT().notice: Maximum time per emergency exit stage before forceAdvanceExit() can be called.         6 hours gives sufficient time for Aave withdrawal + wstETH unwrap under normal conditions.         If a stage hangs (Aave paused, Curve pool drained), coldWallet can force-advance after 6h.

checkStETHPeg().notice: Check if stETH is trading at peg vs ETH. Sets stEthDepeg flag if deviation > threshold.

compoundYield(uint256).notice: Compound accrued yield back into the Aave position.

deployLongLeg().notice: Deploy ETH from the Safe multisig treasury into the long leg.

detectAavePause().notice: Check if Aave v3 is paused. Sets aavePaused flag. Callable by anyone.

executeAaveWithdrawal().notice: Stage 1 — Withdraw wstETH from Aave v3

executeTransferToDeed().notice: Stage 3 — Transfer stETH to deed wallet

forceAdvanceExitStage().notice: Force advance a stuck exit stage

getAccruedYield().notice: Returns yield accrued since last harvest (aToken balance - totalDeployed).

getExitStatus().notice: Returns the current emergency exit state and progress.

getHealthFactor().notice: Returns current Aave health factor in WAD (1e18 = 1.0x).

paramTimelock().notice: Timelock for parameter changes.         Policy: set to 0 for instant changes on your own vault.         Set higher if you want a safety delay (e.g. 48 hours).         Min 0 (instant), Max 7 days.

queueMaxDeployment(uint256).notice: Queue a maxDeployment change.  Hard bound: 0 < max ≤ 12,000 ETH.

requestWithdrawal().notice: Queue a withdrawal request. Starts the withdrawalTimelock countdown.

setLidoQueueAlert(bool).notice: Set the Lido queue congestion alert flag.

setWithdrawalTimelock(uint256).notice: Set the withdrawal timelock. 0 = instant access (private vault default). Max 7 days.

withdrawAll().notice: Withdraw all deployed ETH from Aave. Requires timelock elapsed (if set).

withdrawPartial(uint256).notice: Withdraw a specific ETH amount from Aave. Health factor enforced.

withdrawalTimelock().notice: The delta-neutral strategy does NOT lose yield during this window.Withdrawal delay — configurable by Safe multisig.         Private vault: set as low as 1 hour if you are the sole operator.         Min 1 hour enforced to prevent instant drain even with compromised Safe.
